name: query_disgenets
description: Get gene-disease associations from DisGeNET with association scores (requires data lake volume mounted)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.data_lake import query_disgenets; result = query_disgenets('BRCA1', top_k=20)

parameters.top_k: int — number of top disease associations to return (default 20)

returns: dict with keys: gene, diseases (list of {disease_name, score, disease_id}), source
